notes: The roster recast of 2026-10-28: Ambrose 'Choir' Halloran (one Welder and six Whistlers; was Arc's Welder octet), Orla 'Loom' Vey (Webbers and Legion Ballistas; replaces Ceil Rat), Thessaly 'Hundred' Orne (Hecatoncheir and Cleavers; replaces the Marauder pair). Merged by tools/author_bonds_v1.py.

C.title: Tempo
beats: Sallow is patching a lab with his welder, fast and badly. Halloran watches for a whole minute, then taps the beat on the Welder's hull.
It's a weld, not a hymn.
Everything is a hymn if you count it. Slow your hand. Let the metal come in on the beat.
Huh. It holds. Don't tell anyone you were nice to me.

motifs: two ways to own the air

C.title: Out of time
beats: Volt's Jaguars light up a gunship a half-second before the Whistlers are ready. The Blitz pile in after it.
I came in first. Sight is a wound you give them.
A wound is a solo. I'm running a choir.

C.title: Evensong
beats: The Archangel's missiles and the Whistlers' go up together at dusk. The sky over the company is very quiet afterwards.
Someone has to. You take the high notes.
So is timing. Same time tomorrow.

motifs: weather from above against the choir below
who gets the last word in the sky

C.title: Overhead
beats: Thresh's Hailstorm comes home low over the company. Six Whistlers track it all the way in.
The choir sings at anything that flies over without a hymn sheet.
Then weather gets the loud part.

motifs: gunships the choir keeps singing at
low passes over a nervous battery

C.title: Low pass
beats: The Marsh sisters buzz the Whistler park on their way home. Twice.
Say it higher. The sopranos don't know you yet.
Saffi says your sopranos need glasses.

C.title: Fix
beats: Vey's Webbers pin a column in place. Halq is already reading out its grid square.
They'll hold as long as you need. Nothing in the net moves.
Then the rockets have all night.
Don't take all night. I want the wrecks.

C.title: Salvage
beats: The Webbers strip a field of wrecks down to bare ash. The Auditor counts the metal as it comes in.
Four hundred and twelve, reclaimed. You leave nothing on the ground.
A net that leaves things behind has a hole in it.
I would like that sentence on the ledger.
Put it in the margin. That's where the mending goes.

C.title: Webs
beats: A Recluse and a Webber meet on the same cliff face and stop.
The hive grows. Yours only catch.
Mine catch yours, if they wander into my line.
Then the hive will grow around your line.

C.title: Caught
beats: Stride's Gunslingers tear through the line at full speed and run straight into an EMP pulse.
You were in a hurry. Now you're not. That's the whole lesson.
The net doesn't know that. Slow down where it can see you.

C.title: Holding pattern
beats: Vane's Phobos reform behind the line, fidgeting, while the Webbers hold the enemy still.
Release them. We have a rhythm.
And I have a net. Your rhythm can wait four seconds.
Four seconds is a whole song.
Then it's a short song. Go when I open it.

C.title: Shared sky
beats: Noctua's fighters and Orne's drones share the same patch of sky without a single collision.
You fly them like a hand.
We are a hand. You fly yours like a dream.
Then we sleep in the same sky.

motifs: a carrier on legs and a carrier on wings

C.title: Inventory
beats: The Myrmidon and the Hecatoncheir launch their drones over the same ridge.
I count fourteen of yours and sixteen of mine.
We count thirty of ours. They are all ours, from up here.
That is not how ownership works.
It is how the sky works.

motifs: we are the eyes, we are the hands

C.title: We
beats: Tick's bay prints another wave of fleas. Orne's drones fly over them in formation.

motifs: a merchant wing and a carrier

C.title: Airspace
beats: Marrow Gale's Cutlasses and Orne's drones arrive over the same shoreline from opposite directions.
This stretch of water is spoken for.
Mercenaries have contracts. What do drones have?

C.title: Audience
beats: Ferro's Gladiators bow to an enemy line. Above them, Orne's drones hold perfectly still in the air.
Finally, an audience that pays attention.
We watch everything. You are the best part.

C.title: Traps
beats: Cinder Hook seeds the approach with mines. Vey's Webbers stand just behind the minefield, waiting.
Nets after it. Whatever steps around your mines walks into my line.
And whatever you catch, I can blow up at leisure.
